Not Just Musicians—Complete Cultural Experiences

Krishna Music School Pushkar curates and produces large-scale live concerts and stage programs blending Rajasthani folk, Sufi, Bollywood, fusion, and devotional music with world-class stagecraft. These aren’t small performances—they’re spectacular cultural productions featuring 20-100 performers, full technical production (sound, lighting, LED walls), choreographed staging, and multi-act storytelling that captivates audiences of 500-5,000+ at international festivals, destination weddings, corporate galas, tourism showcases, and grand cultural evenings.

What Makes Grand Concert Productions Different

❌ Standard Music Performance

  • 4-8 musicians only
  • Basic sound system
  • Minimal staging requirements
  • Limited visual appeal
  • 1-hour duration typical
  • Musicians arrive and play

✨ Grand Concert Production

  • 20-100 performers (musicians, dancers, supporting artists)
  • Full technical production (32-ch sound, concert lighting, LED walls)
  • Choreographed staging (entries, exits, costume changes, visual storytelling)
  • Spectacular visuals (traditional costumes, cultural props, dance formations)
  • Multi-act structure (2-3 hour shows with intermissions, thematic progression)
  • Production team (stage manager, technical director, coordinators)

Show Formats & Themes

Six signature concert formats designed for different audiences, occasions, and cultural preferences.

Cultural

Royal Rajasthan Folk Ensemble

15-25 Performers | 90-120 mins | ₹1,50,000-₹3,00,000

Best For: Tourism boards, cultural festivals, heritage hotels, international audiences

Team: 8-10 musicians (vocals, harmonium, dholak, tabla, khartal, morchang, nagada, algoza, ravanahatta) + 5-8 Kalbeliya/Ghoomar dancers + 2-3 supporting folk artists

Musical Repertoire:

  • Traditional Rajasthani folk songs (Kesariya Balam, Moomal, Gorband)
  • Desert ballads and legends with storytelling
  • Wedding folk songs (Banna Banni, Saso Ki Mala)
  • Instrumental showcases (morchang solo, algoza duet)

Visual Spectacle: Colorful traditional costumes (bright ghagras, turbans), cultural props (matkas/pots, fire performance optional), circular Ghoomar and snake-like Kalbeliya dance formations, stage backdrop with Rajasthan desert/palace visuals

⭐ Popular

Sufi & Qawwali Mehfil

10-15 Performers | 90-150 mins | ₹1,20,000-₹2,50,000

Best For: Spiritual festivals, Sufi events, cultural nights, intimate large gatherings (300-800)

Team: 5-7 qawwals (lead vocalists + chorus) + Harmonium player + Tabla & dholak percussionists + 3-4 supporting clap chorus

Musical Repertoire:

  • Classic qawwalis (Khwaja Mere Khwaja, Kun Faya Kun, Dam Mast Qalandar)
  • Sufi poetry of Rumi, Kabir, Bulleh Shah set to music
  • Devotional fusion (Sufi + Rajasthani folk blend)
  • Audience participation (clap rhythms, repetitive phrases)

Visual Approach: Simple elegant white/cream costumes, focused stage lighting (single spotlight on lead vocalist), seated traditional mehfil arrangement, minimal props—focus entirely on music and transcendent emotion

Book This Format
High Energy

Bollywood Live Band Extravaganza

12-20 Performers | 90-120 mins | ₹2,50,000-₹5,00,000

Best For: Corporate galas, destination wedding receptions, New Year’s parties, youth festivals

Team: 2 lead vocalists (male + female) + 5-6 musicians (guitar, bass, drums, keyboard, saxophone, violin) + 4-6 Bollywood-style dancers + Optional DJ for pre/post-show

Musical Repertoire:

  • Bollywood chart-toppers (last 10 years)
  • Romantic classics (90s-2000s hits: Tum Hi Ho, Gerua)
  • High-energy dance numbers (Badtameez Dil, Gallan Goodiyaan, Kala Chashma)
  • Fusion: Bollywood meets folk (Ghoomar from Padmaavat)

Show Flow: Opening high-energy dance medley (10m) → Romantic classics set (20m) → Professional dancers solo showcase (10m) → Chart-topping hits (25m) → Finale audience on-stage sing-along dance party (15m)

Visual Production: Contemporary glamorous costumes, choreographed dance routines synchronized with music, dynamic LED wall visuals (Bollywood movie scenes, graphics), smoke/fog effects for dramatic entries

Fusion

East-West Fusion Orchestra

15-25 Performers | 120-180 mins | ₹3,00,000-₹7,00,000

Best For: International music festivals, embassy events, cross-cultural celebrations, corporate internationals

Team: 8-10 Indian classical/folk musicians + 5-7 Western instrumentalists (guitar, bass, drums, piano, sax, violin) + 2-4 fusion dancers (contemporary + Indian classical blend)

Musical Repertoire:

  • Original fusion compositions by Krishna Music School
  • Raga-jazz improvisations (Sitar + Piano dialogues)
  • Folk-flamenco crossovers (Rajasthani rhythms + Spanish guitar)
  • World music collaborations (Sufi-reggae, tribal-electronic)
  • Bollywood hits reimagined in sophisticated fusion arrangements

Unique Features: Live improvisation segments, musician spotlights (each artist gets solo moment), cultural bridge narrative (MC explains fusion concepts between sets), guest artist integration possible

Mega

Grand Cultural Spectacular

50-100 Performers | 150-210 mins | ₹5,00,000-₹10,00,000+

Best For: State tourism showcases, international festivals, major corporate galas, government events (1,000-5,000 guests)

Team: 15-20 musicians (full folk + classical + fusion orchestra) + 20-30 dancers (Kalbeliya, Ghoomar, Chari, Teratali, contemporary) + 10-15 supporting folk artists (acrobats, fire performers, puppeteers) + 5-10 production crew

Show Structure:

  • Act 1: Rajasthan Awakens—folk ensemble opening (30 mins)
  • Act 2: Royal Court—classical dance and music (25 mins)
  • Intermission (20 mins)
  • Act 3: Desert Celebrations—wedding folk + mass dance (30 mins)
  • Act 4: Modern Rajasthan—fusion + Bollywood high energy (25 mins)
  • Grand Finale: All performers on stage, climactic sequence (15 mins)

Technical Production: 32-channel sound system with sub-woofers, 40+ stage lights (moving heads, wash lights, LED pars), LED wall 20ft x 10ft minimum, smoke machines, CO2 cannons, confetti blasters, live multi-camera video feed, wireless mic systems for 15+ performers

Visual Spectacle: Multiple costume changes (3-4 per performer), 100+ cultural props, choreographed mass formations (50+ people synchronized), special effects (fire breathing, sword swallowing, aerial silk optional)

Spiritual

Devotional & Spiritual Evening

10-15 Performers | 90-120 mins | ₹80,000-₹1,50,000

Best For: Yoga festivals, spiritual retreats, ashram events, wellness resort programs, religious gatherings

Team: 5-7 devotional vocalists (bhajan singers) + Harmonium, tabla, manjira + Optional: sitar, bansuri for instrumental meditation

  • Krishna bhajans (Hare Krishna, Govind Bolo, Radhe Radhe)

Visual Approach: Simple white/saffron attire, candles and incense ambiance, flower decorations, soft warm lighting (no harsh spotlights), minimalist stage with floor seating or low platforms

Full Technical Production Capability

We don’t just provide artists—we produce complete concerts with professional sound, lighting, staging, and technical management.

🔊 Sound Engineering

Small Venues (100-300): 16-ch mixer, 4-6 speakers, 6-8 wireless mics, 4 monitors

Medium Venues (300-800): 24-ch mixer, 8-10 speakers + subs, 10-12 mics, 6 monitors

Large Venues (800-2000+): 32-ch digital mixer, line array speakers, 15+ mics, 8-10 monitors, dedicated sound technician team

Pre-event site visit, custom stage plot, 3-4 hour sound check, dedicated engineers, backup equipment on standby

💡 Lighting Design

Basic Package: 12-20 LED par lights, 4-6 wash lights, basic DMX control

Standard Package: 20-30 LED lights, 8-10 moving heads, fog machine, DMX programmer

Premium Package: 40+ lights, 15+ moving heads, LED wall, haze/smoke, CO2, confetti, dedicated lighting designer

Act-specific lighting moods, spotlight following for solos, color washes synchronized to music, special effects timed to climactic moments

🎬 Video & Visual Production

LED Wall Integration: Cultural visuals (Rajasthan landscapes, palace architecture), live lyrics display (sing-along moments), sponsor logos and branding (corporate events), live camera feed (close-ups of performers), thematic graphics synchronized to acts

Documentation (Add-On): Multi-camera recording, professional photography throughout show, highlight reel editing and delivery, social media content package

Stage & Set Design Requirements

10-15 Performers

Stage: 20ft x 15ft minimum

Height: 3-4ft elevation recommended

Load Capacity: 2,000+ lbs

Power: 220V, 30 amp circuits

20-30 Performers

Stage: 30ft x 20ft recommended

Height: 4-5ft elevation ideal

Load Capacity: 4,000+ lbs

Power: 220V, 60 amp circuits

50+ Performers

Stage: 40ft x 30ft+ required

Height: 5-6ft elevation for visibility

Load Capacity: 8,000+ lbs

Power: 220V, 100+ amp circuits

Set Elements We Provide/Coordinate: Backdrop (fabric, LED wall, or custom set pieces), risers for tiered musician placement, dance floor marking/protection, cultural props and set dressing, green room setup coordination

What Audiences Experience at Our Grand Concerts

🎨

Visual Grandeur

Colorful traditional costumes with multiple changes throughout show. Stage choreography with planned entrances, exits, and formations. Cultural props (100+ items for large productions—pots, swords, shields, puppets). LED wall visuals synchronized to acts. Dancers in formation creating stunning visual tableaus.

🔊

Immersive Sound

Surrounding folk and fusion rhythms with modern audio clarity. Multiple layers: traditional instruments, modern amplification, vocal harmonies. Bass frequencies you feel in your chest during peak moments. Crystal-clear vocals even in 2,000+ capacity venues. Balanced mix where every instrument is audible.

🙌

Interactive Elements

Call-and-response singing (audience repeats phrases). Clap-along rhythms taught and integrated into songs. Sing-along moments for familiar Bollywood hits. Dance participation (brave audience members invited on stage). Cultural education (MC explains significance between acts).

📖

Cultural Storytelling

Narratives of Rajasthani traditions woven through show. Historical context for folk songs and dances. Bilingual hosting explains cultural significance. Journey structure (desert dawn → royal court → village celebration → modern fusion). Emotional arc building from calm opening to ecstatic finale.

🌍

Modern Appeal

Fusion tracks with jazz, flamenco, reggae influences. Bollywood numbers everyone recognizes. Contemporary staging and lighting (not museum-piece presentation). Global instrumentation (sitar + guitar, tabla + drums). Appeals to both traditional enthusiasts and modern audiences.

📱

Instagrammable Moments

Designed for social media sharing and viral potential. Dramatic lighting changes create photo opportunities. Colorful costumes and props photograph beautifully. Dance formations from aerial perspective (for venue cameras). Fire performances and special effects (smoke, confetti) at climactic moments.

Booking Process for Large-Scale Productions

1

Initial Inquiry

Contact with date, location, event type, audience size, budget range. We respond within 6-12 hours with preliminary availability and conceptual overview.

2

Consultation Call

45-60 min video/phone call with decision-makers. Understand event goals, audience demographics, venue specifics. Discuss format preferences and technical capabilities.

3

Site Visit

For ₹3L+ events, our production team visits venue. Assess stage space, power supply, acoustics, load-in logistics. Meet venue technical team. Take measurements and photos for planning.

4

Custom Proposal

Delivered in 5-7 days: 15-25 page detailed proposal with recommended format, artist lineup, act-by-act show flow, technical rider, stage plot, budget breakdown, artist bios, sample videos, timeline.

5

Refinement

Review proposal together. Make adjustments to lineup, duration, technical specs. Finalize budget and payment terms. Clarify questions.

6

Contract

Performance agreement signed. 30-40% advance payment secures date and artists. Technical rider formally shared with venue. Timeline locked in.

7

Pre-Production

4-6 weeks before: Bi-weekly check-ins on logistics. Final guest count confirmation. Sponsor/branding integration. Coordinate load-in/load-out with venue. Finalize hospitality needs.

8

Final Coordination

1-2 weeks before: Production meeting with all stakeholders. Final run-of-show document shared. Backup plans for weather. Emergency contacts exchanged.

9

Show Day

Team arrives 8-12 hours early. Load-in, stage setup, sound check, lighting programming. Final rehearsal with full cast. VIP/artist coordination. Show execution. Controlled breakdown.

⏰ Timeline: Minimum 8 weeks. Recommended 12-16 weeks for large productions. Ideal 20-24 weeks for international festivals. Peak Season (Oct-Feb): Book 24-32 weeks ahead.

Frequently Asked Questions

What’s included in your turnkey production service?

Everything: All artists (musicians, dancers, supporting performers), costumes and props, sound system with technicians, lighting design with operators, stage management team, technical rider and logistics coordination, pre-event site visit (₹3L+ events), sound check and rehearsals, post-event breakdown. You provide venue, power, and stage—we handle the rest.

How far in advance should we book for a grand concert?

Minimum 8 weeks. Recommended 12-16 weeks for large productions (50+ performers). Ideal 20-24 weeks for international festivals or multi-day events. Peak season (Oct-Feb) book 24-32 weeks ahead. Weekend dates in peak season fill first.

Can you customize shows for corporate branding?

Yes! We integrate corporate logos on LED walls, create branded musical experiences (opening songs with company messaging), coordinate with product launches, incorporate award ceremonies into show flow, and even create custom song parodies (additional creative fee). Professional, sophisticated branding that doesn’t feel forced.

Do you travel internationally?

Yes! We’ve performed internationally and welcome inquiries. International bookings require: Minimum 16-24 weeks advance planning, flight and accommodation costs for team (negotiated based on show scale), visa assistance coordination, equipment rental coordination in destination country (we bring key instruments, rent sound/lights locally), cultural briefing for local audience context.

What if our venue doesn’t have adequate sound/lighting?

No problem—that’s why we offer turnkey production. During site visit (or video assessment), we determine venue capabilities. We then either: (1) Bring portable production equipment (included in quote), (2) Coordinate professional rental from trusted vendors (quoted separately), or (3) Work with venue’s existing equipment if it meets our standards. We always have backup equipment on standby.

Can we combine multiple formats in one show?

Absolutely! That’s a popular option. Example: 30 mins Rajasthani folk opening → 25 mins Sufi qawwali segment → 20 mins Bollywood finale. We design multi-act shows that take audiences on cultural journeys. Total duration typically 90-150 minutes for multi-format shows.

What’s the difference between ₹2L and ₹8L productions?

Scale and complexity. ₹2L: 12-20 performers, standard sound/lighting, 90-min show, single format. ₹8L: 50-100 performers, premium technical production (32-ch sound, LED wall, 40+ lights, special effects), 150-210 min multi-act show, multiple formats, full production crew, extensive choreography, multi-camera documentation. Both are professional—₹8L is stadium-scale spectacular.

Do you offer multi-event discounts for weddings?

Yes! Book 3+ events and receive 15-20% discount on total. Example: Sangeet + Welcome Dinner + Reception = 18% discount. Plus benefits: Consistent team across all events, varied repertoire each evening (no repetition), dedicated wedding coordinator, priority scheduling for peak season dates, complimentary highlight reel across all events.

Can guests participate or join the performance?

Yes, most of our shows include interactive segments! Depending on format: Clap-along rhythms (taught and integrated), call-and-response singing (repeat phrases), Bollywood sing-alongs (familiar hits), dance participation (brave guests invited on stage), instrument try-outs (simple percussion). For corporate events, we can integrate team members into planned segments with advance coordination.

What happens if weather forces us to move indoor/postpone?

Weather backup plans discussed during pre-production. Options: (1) Move to indoor backup venue (we adapt setup), (2) Tent/canopy coverage (we assess if our equipment is rain-safe), (3) Postpone to alternate date (if within 3 days, no penalty; beyond that, case-by-case), (4) Covered outdoor venues always recommended for rainy season (July-Sep). We monitor weather forecasts week prior and proactively communicate.
